gemini_original_output.answer:
Heather's observed response function can only be estimated conditionally on incoming message types from a single sender, Sam (romantic partner / former partner). Across all provided screenshots, there are zero observed instances of Heather responding to any other sender (all interactions involving Joey, Terry, Partu, Khari Rodriguez, Bounty, Janey, and AnnElisa are either incoming monologues, conversations strictly with Sam, or lack Heather's participation). Consequently, the effect of 'sender type' is completely unidentifiable and cannot be estimated due to zero variation in sender identity.

Conditional on Sam's incoming message types (derived inductively across 17 distinct, deduplicated turn-taking reply pairs), Heather exhibits marked, pattern-specific response behaviors:
1. Logistical inquiries & coordination prompts (e.g., location queries, arrival checks): Heather responds almost exclusively with concise logistical and real-time coordination (L01) at 100% (5/5).
2. Direct accusations, cross-examination, and suspicion regarding other men/infidelity: Heather responds by addressing suspicions and denying infidelity (L02) and/or asserting boundaries/relational exit (L05), accompanied in several instances by emotional distress (L03) (e.g., IMG_3505, IMG_9383).
3. Relational pressure, guilt-inducing commentary, and reconciliation bids: Heather's responses split between emotional distress/hurt/vulnerability (L03) and affection/apology/longing (L04), occasionally offering narrative accounts of outside interactions (L06) or boundary withdrawal (L05).
4. Affectionate, supportive, or conciliatory messages: Heather reciprocates with affection, apology, or gratitude (L04) at 100% (2/2; IMG_2530:5, IMG_8976:7).
5. Technical/account queries & general post-separation check-ins: Heather asserts boundary independence (L05) and shares third-party personal narratives (L06).

messages.text: I had a very short list of people that I thought would actually come but not even the people that I thought cared at a little bit didn't come fuck they didn't even ask why my mom is dying or of what she is dying from and believe me I will never forget what I learned tonight I learned that sooner than I thought I am going to have to say goodbye to my mom but before I do there's a lot of people that I will say goodbye to I feel so stupid because I thought you would be here for me not because of any thing except that I thought we were fuck I guess we weren't anything special at not to you goodbye 12 good luck wish you all the best
